text: At the February 2022 meeting of Toronto East York Community Council authorized the installation of speed bumps in Cosmos Nature Lane, bounded by Bloor Street West, Margueretta Street, Wallace Avenue and Brock Avenue (TE31.96). To further deter speeding in the laneway and enhance safety, I am requesting that a speed bump be installed at the entry of the laneway, which operates east-west, located south of Wallace Avenue and west of Brock Avenue.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized the installation of a speed bump in Cosmos Nature Lane (east-west section), south of Wallace Avenue, west of Brock Avenue, as shown on 'Drawing 421G-4002', dated April 2022, from the Director, Traffic Management, Transportation Services.
